gotchas: QRR is the dominant Q1 heating term; CSD19532Q5B (249 nC) would add about 2.2 W at 46.8 V, hence BSC040N10NS5 as Q2.
MLCC Ceff taken as 55-160 uF. All eFuse-gated downstream ceramics add Ceff; Bode swept to 160 uF.
Hold-up: UVLO off must stay at or below 20 V or the hold-up calc fails; set 18.2 V here.
Q1 total about 3.2 W at 46.8 V, Q2 about 0.9 W. SLPS483 RthJA 40 C/W on 1 in2 2 oz: Q1 needs copper spreading on the 6-layer stack or airflow; thermal not simulated.
TI Design 2 (48 V to 12 V 10 A, 400 kHz, p43-44) is the base; this design moves to 300 kHz for efficiency with a larger L.
MOSFET gate charge taken at 10 V as a conservative stand-in for VCC 7.5 V.
VCC bias from 12 V VOUT via D_VCC cuts LDO loss (58-7.5 V)*14 mA=0.7 W; ext VCC must be 8-13 V and below VIN (p7, p43).
Pin 15 and EP are internally connected and electrically isolated; connect EP to AGND and PGND plane (p5).
SYNCIN high or VCC forces FPWM; low or floating gives diode emulation at light load (p5, p26).
